how to be so unbothered it
confuses everyone around you

the pause before replying

when someone says something that stings, wait three full seconds before you answer. a calm pause shows them their words didn't land where they aimed, and it changes the room.

no long explanations

say no without a paragraph of reasons. a short, kind no tells people your time is yours, and the less you justify yourself, the less they try to negotiate with you.

letting them be wrong

the next time someone gets a small fact wrong about you, let it go. people who don't need to win every little argument look like they have nothing left to prove.

a mind full of other things

spend 5 minutes a day learning something with no link to your problems: a lost civilisation, a planet, a painter. a mind with more in it has less room for other people's drama.

spend 5 minutes a day learning something unrelated to your problems: a lost civilisation, a planet. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, and drama gets less room.

walking slower

slow your walk down by a third for one week, especially when you're late. rushing tells everyone you're under pressure, and slowing down tells them nothing can push you.
